outcome: Enrichment of genes associated with hypoxia
Enrichment of genes associated with inflammatory responses
cohort: The study included term placentae from neonates categorized into three birthweight centile groups: less than the 10th BWC (n=39), between the 10th and 30th BWC (n=15), and greater than the 30th BWC (n=23).
finding: Placentae of neonates <10th BWC (regardless of sex) and male placentae of neonates between the 10th-30th BWC exhibited enrichment of genes associated with hypoxia, inflammation, and sex hormone responses, suggesting placental dysfunction.
birth_weight: Categorized by birthweight centile: <10th BWC, 10th-30th BWC, >30th BWC.
